Topping Company offers a natural dog cloth made from natural materials that helps prevent skin allergies and reduces waste. Our story began with the idea of ‘Love Pets, Love the World,’ because we saw two big problems: chemical pet products and waste that stays on our planet for a long time. Our goal is to make safe products for dogs, protect the planet, and create jobs for local communities. We serve dog owners who care about their pets‘ health and people who choose eco-friendly products. What makes us different is that our cloth is 100% chemical-free, breaks down naturally in three weeks, is handmade by local communities, and is Certified Humane and approved by the DLD.
